record.name: Yale University
record.cycle_quote: Review the 2026-2027 essay topics for all applications.

prompts.text: Students at Yale have time to explore their academic interests before committing to one or more major fields of study. Many students either modify their original academic direction or change their minds entirely. As of this moment, what academic areas seem to fit your interests or goals most comfortably? Please indicate up to three from the list provided.
prompts.quote: All first-year applicants will respond to the following short answer questions:

prompts.text: Tell us about a topic or idea that excites you and is related to one or more academic areas you selected above. Why are you drawn to it? (200 words or fewer)
prompts.quote: All first-year applicants will respond to the following short answer questions:

prompts.text: If you could teach any college course, write a book, or create an original piece of art of any kind, what would it be?
prompts.quote: Common Application and Coalition Application only: respond to the following short answer questions, in no more than 200 characters (approximately 35 words):

prompts.text: What is one aspect of yourself that you hope to grow or develop during college?
prompts.quote: Common Application and Coalition Application only: respond to the following short answer questions, in no more than 200 characters (approximately 35 words):

prompts.text: What is something about you that is not included anywhere else in your application?
prompts.quote: Common Application and Coalition Application only: respond to the following short answer questions, in no more than 200 characters (approximately 35 words):

prompts.text: Reflect on a time you discussed an issue important to you with someone holding an opposing view. Why did you find the experience meaningful?
prompts.quote: Common Application and Coalition Application only: respond to one of the following prompts in 400 words or fewer.

prompts.text: Reflect on your membership in a community to which you feel connected. Why is this community meaningful to you? You may define community however you like.
